hikes.name: Mima Mounds
hikes.blurb: A prairie of mysterious grass-covered hummocks, blue with camas in spring.

hikes.name: Tumwater Falls
hikes.blurb: A short loop down both banks of the Deschutes River's falls at the head of Budd Inlet.

hikes.name: Larch Mountain
hikes.blurb: From Rock Candy Trailhead, a 14.9-mile round trip to the top of Larch Mountain (2,537 ft), with about 3,050 feet of climbing.
